card.text: M1-67 is the nebula around the Wolf-Rayet star WR 124, about 6,400 parsecs away.

sources.label: Zavala et al. (2022), MNRAS 513, 3317: 3D mapping of the Wolf-Rayet nebula M 1-67
sources.locator: Sect. 1: an estimated distance of 6.4 (+2.5, −0.8) kpc

sources.label: Wikipedia, "M1-67"
sources.quote: M1-67, also known as Merrill's Star Nebula, is an ejecta nebula that surrounds the Wolf–Rayet star WR 124, which is about 6.4 kpc from Earth in the constellation of Sagitta.

introduction.text: The star threw it off about 11,800 years ago: clumps of gas and dust in two lobes and a waist, still expanding at up to 90 km/s.

sources.label: Zavala et al. (2022), MNRAS 513, 3317: 3D mapping of the Wolf-Rayet nebula M 1-67
sources.locator: Sect. 6: a kinematic age of 11.8 (+4.6, −0.8) kyr; a bipolar structure with a torus about it, the bipolar structure with maximum velocities of 90 km/s

sources.quote: It contains dust which is caught up in WR 124's solar wind and which absorbs much of the star's light.
